meta_title: Vio The Handyman | Handyman Services Liverpool
meta_description: Vio The Handyman offers reliable, affordable handyman services across Liverpool. From flat-pack assembly to repairs and odd jobs — call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Handyman — Liverpool & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Tired of jobs piling up at home? Vio gets them done quickly, cleanly, and at a fair price.
services_subhead: From small repairs and DIY fixes to larger home improvement tasks, Vio handles it all with care and expertise.

services.title: Flat-Pack Assembly
services.desc: IKEA, Argos, or any flat-pack furniture assembled quickly and correctly. No stripped screws, no leftover parts — just solid, sturdy results.

services.title: Picture & Shelf Hanging
services.desc: Mirrors, artwork, shelving units, and TV brackets fitted securely to any wall type, including plasterboard and brick.

services.title: Door & Lock Repairs
services.desc: Stiff, sticking, or misaligned doors fixed and rehung properly. Locks replaced or repaired to keep your home secure.

services.title: General Home Repairs
services.desc: Leaky gutters, cracked skirting boards, dripping taps, and all those niggling jobs that never quite get done — sorted in one visit.

services.title: Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Rooms, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls painted to a clean, professional finish. Preparation done properly so results last.

services.title: Garden & Outdoor Tasks
services.desc: Fence panel repairs, gate rehinging, shed assembly, and minor outdoor maintenance to keep your property looking its best year-round.

about_pullquote: Every job matters to me, whether it's one screw or a full day's work.
about_para_1: Vio The Handyman has been helping Liverpool homeowners and tenants tackle their to-do lists for over a decade. Based in Fairfield, L7, Vio brings a practical, no-nonsense approach to every job — big or small — arriving on time and leaving the place tidy.
about_para_2: What sets Vio apart is straightforward pricing, honest advice, and the kind of attention to detail that keeps customers coming back and recommending to their neighbours. There are no call-out fees, no inflated quotes, and no surprises on the invoice.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Residents Say About Vio

reviews.text: Vio came round the same day I called and sorted out three jobs I'd been putting off for months. Shelves up, a door that finally closes properly, and a broken fence panel fixed. Brilliant value and a really tidy worker.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Assembled a whole bedroom's worth of flat-pack furniture in no time at all. Dead professional, friendly, and left no mess whatsoever. Will definitely be calling again for the next lot of jobs.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Honest pricing, turned up exactly when he said he would, and did a great job painting our hallway. You can tell he takes pride in his work. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend Vio to anyone in Liverpool.
reviews.author: Diane H.
